features.title: An exam workspace built for reliability.

library.title: Smart question bank
library.description: Keep multiple choice, essay, grouped questions, and different answer formats in one central library.

schedule.title: Flexible exam scheduling

security.title: Monitoring and cheating prevention
security.description: Lock screens, flag violations, limit login devices, and record unusual activity in real time.

analytics.title: Clear analytics and reports
analytics.description: Review score distributions, completion rates, difficult questions, and downloadable instructor reports.

create.title: Create an exam
